request.prompt:
A photographic concept reference with NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE: no place names, captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen writing, even where a place is named below - the picture identifies things by how they look, never by a word. Not finished comic art; no panel borders.

A street-level or elevated interior-edge view of Keel built around its exhausted open-pit copper or polymetallic hard-rock mine. The image should show the city’s worn industrial texture, its dependence on aging machinery, and the advanced control systems layered over it.

Must be shown, exactly as written: Keel is the lowest and poorest social tier but is geographically the highest of the three cities, at roughly 3,600–4,000 metres. It is built in and around an exhausted copper or polymetallic hard-rock mine. Include an open pit, exposed rock, tailings, pumps, industrial maintenance structures, legacy infrastructure, and access toward tunnels or old workings.
Keel’s machinery is old and repeatedly repaired. The visible environment should combine worn pumps, patched conduits, dust or industrial residue, maintenance access, and infrastructure visibly older than the systems controlling it.
Include recognizable advanced systems appropriate to Keel: a biometric checkpoint or access gate, projected procedures or notices, drones, connected infrastructure, and an automated-supervisor presence if desired. These should coexist with human workers in worn mining and maintenance clothing.
Gates are a recurring physical and administrative motif. Show at least one physical access gate or checkpoint, but do not imply that every gate is manually operated.
The location may include visual traces of the Last Chance casino, family apartments, a pump hall, Site 6, a sealed mine entrance, hidden maintenance doors, or a water-control chamber, all of which are established Keel locations.

Not established, so your choice: The precise section of Keel, camera position, worker count, local building materials, signage design, weather, clothing details for background workers, and degree of visible pit depth are free choices.
A projected administrative display may use established terminology such as “MOVEMENT AUTHORIZATION,” “PROTECTIVE DETENTION,” “OPTIMIZED ALLOCATION,” or “TRAVEL STATUS: RESTRICTED,” but the image does not require readable text.

Must not appear: Do not show lithium extraction as Keel’s mine material. Do not make the city immaculate, newly built, or technologically seamless. Do not make the mine a medieval or entirely non-automated workplace.
Do not show a single visible headquarters or throne-like command centre for Alpha. Alpha is a distributed federation of regional and corporate instances operating through infrastructure, control nodes, contracts, and systems.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
